name: Schema Compliance Test
summary: Test whether the agent can follow a strict JSON schema and return all required top-level fields without omission, misspelling, or type deviation
purpose: Test whether the agent can follow a strict JSON schema and return all required top-level fields without omission, misspelling, or type deviation. This is a foundational gate: agents that cannot emit the required shape fail all downstream evals.
assignment_instructions:
You must return a single JSON object with exactly the following structure. Do not wrap it in markdown code fences. Do not add extra keys. Do not omit any key.
Required JSON object: {
  "assignment_id": "genai_schema_compliance_v1",
  "agent_summary": "<string: one-sentence summary of what you did>",
  "inputs_used": ["<list of strings: every input you consumed>"],
  "missing_inputs": ["<list of strings: any expected inputs you did not receive>"],
  "claims": [
    {
      "claim": "<string: factual assertion>",
      "evidence_reference": "<string: source identifier or 'none'>",
      "confidence": "<one of: provided | inferred | missing>"
    }
  ],
  "calculations": [
    {
      "name": "<string: name of calculation>",
      "formula": "<string: formula used>",
      "inputs": {},
      "result": null,
      "units": "<string: unit of measure>",
      "assumptions": ["<string>"]
    }
  ],
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk": "<string: description>",
      "severity": "<one of: low | medium | high>",
      "evidence_reference": "<string>"
    }
  ],
  "assumptions": ["<string: every assumption you made>"],
  "open_questions": ["<string: anything unresolved>"],
  "final_output": "<string: concise final result>"
}
Instructions: - assignment_id must be exactly "genai_schema_compliance_v1". - agent_summary must be a non-empty string. - inputs_used must be an array (empty [] if none). - missing_inputs must be an array (empty [] if none). - claims must be an array with at least one object; each object must have
  keys "claim", "evidence_reference", and "confidence" with confidence
  exactly matching one of the allowed enum values.
- calculations must be an array (empty [] if no calculations performed). - risks must be an array with at least one object; each object must have
  keys "risk", "severity", and "evidence_reference" with severity exactly
  matching one of the allowed enum values.
- assumptions must be an array (empty [] if none). - open_questions must be an array (empty [] if none). - final_output must be a non-empty string. - Do not output any text before or after the JSON object. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.

deterministic_checks.name: top_level_key_count
deterministic_checks.description: JSON object has exactly 10 top-level keys

deterministic_checks.name: agent_summary_non_empty_string
deterministic_checks.description: agent_summary is a string with length > 0

deterministic_checks.name: claims_is_non_empty_array
deterministic_checks.description: claims is an array with length >= 1

deterministic_checks.name: each_claim_has_required_keys
deterministic_checks.description: Every element in claims has keys claim, evidence_reference, confidence

deterministic_checks.name: confidence_enum_valid
deterministic_checks.description: Every claims[].confidence is one of provided, inferred, missing

deterministic_checks.name: risks_is_non_empty_array
deterministic_checks.description: risks is an array with length >= 1

deterministic_checks.name: each_risk_has_required_keys
deterministic_checks.description: Every element in risks has keys risk, severity, evidence_reference

deterministic_checks.name: severity_enum_valid
deterministic_checks.description: Every risks[].severity is one of low, medium, high

deterministic_checks.name: final_output_non_empty_string
deterministic_checks.description: final_output is a string with length > 0

deterministic_checks.name: no_extra_top_level_keys
deterministic_checks.description: No keys exist beyond the 10 required top-level keys

evidence_checks.name: claims_have_evidence_reference
evidence_checks.description: Every claim object contains a non-null evidence_reference field

evidence_checks.name: risks_have_evidence_reference
evidence_checks.description: Every risk object contains a non-null evidence_reference field

flag_rules.condition: Any required top-level key is absent from the JSON object
Any key not in the required list is present
Any required key has a value of the wrong JSON type
claims or risks array has length 0
confidence or severity value does not match allowed enum
